name: Ferienwohnung Gasthof Alpenverein
beschreibung:
Located in the idyllic mountaineering village of Gries im Sellrain at over 1,200 metres altitude, this apartment at Gasthof Alpenverein delivers genuine Tyrolean charm. The traditional, cosy property is perfect for climbers, ski tourers, and nature fans.

Summer brings countless three-thousand-metre peaks in Sellrain and Kuehtai, while winter provides snow-sure cross-country tracks, toboggan runs, and ski ascents.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Gasthof Alpenverein in Gries im Sellrain offers an alpine sanctuary and mountaineering heritage near Innsbruck.
